verdict.rationale: Snowflake documents Apache Iceberg tables that live in external cloud storage you manage (snowflake-docs-50, snowflake-docs-58). Data in those tables is held in an open table format outside Snowflake, which supports leaving. The SQL API also lets you read data programmatically (snowflake-docs-66). However, nothing in the pack covers bulk export or unload of native Snowflake tables to open file formats, or a full account-exit path. Missing for 10: documented unload/export of all native tables to open formats (e.g. Parquet/CSV via COPY INTO a location), export of metadata and objects beyond table data, a documented migration-off path, and independent hands-on corroboration of a full export.
